title: Hours and minutes
prompt: The robot has run for some number of minutes. Return an array with two numbers: whole hours, then the minutes left over. solve(90) is [1, 30].
hints: Whole-number division gives the hours; the remainder gives the minutes.
Return them in square brackets: `[hours, minutes]`.

docs.name: a % b
docs.what: The remainder after dividing a by b. 90 % 60 is 30.

solution:
func solve(total_minutes):
	var hours = total_minutes / 60
	var minutes = total_minutes % 60
	return [hours, minutes]
